usageNotes: Use this to inspect a single node-level firewall rule by its zero-based position in the ruleset. Requires `Sys.Audit` on `/nodes/{node}`. Because rules are position-indexed, pair this with the rule list endpoint first to identify the target `pos` before fetching details.

examples.summary: Fetch the first rule on node pve1 to inspect its action and source filter

tips: Rule positions are zero-based and shift whenever rules are inserted or deleted — always re-query the list after any write operation to get current positions.
The `pos` path param is marked optional in the spec but functionally required; omitting it will cause an API error.
Check the `enable` field (0 or 1) to confirm whether the rule is currently active before troubleshooting connectivity.
